releaseNotes:
v4.5.1 — Home UI/UX Redesign & Performance:
• Redesigned Home screen with section-based feed layout
• New greeting header with time-based display
• Improved Keep Listening with resume action and compact recent items
• Improved Quick Picks with featured card and two-column grid
• Faster search suggestions with in-memory cache and reduced latency
• Local Home interaction metrics for smarter content ranking
• Better empty and loading states across Home sections
• General stability and performance improvements
